text_description: A layered runway look centered on a structured, straight red-and-white patterned coat worn open over multiple blue layers. The coat falls to the upper thigh with a boxy, tailored silhouette, long sleeves, a broad collar/lapel area, visible white-toned buttons, horizontal pocket flaps at the waist, and a dense small-scale woven or printed red lattice pattern on a light ground; scattered black and pale frayed tufts or feather-like threads sit on the shoulder, sleeves, and front, giving the surface a distressed, embellished texture. Underneath is a pale blue collared button-front shirt or shirt-dress with the collar popped high and the neckline open, revealing layered chunky necklaces; the shirt has colorful printed motifs in red, green, and dark tones, including a large green-and-red graphic section visible at the lower front. A sheer blue diamond net layer runs vertically down the center and continues below the coat, creating a transparent mesh overlay that reads like a vest, dress, or skirt layer over the printed shirt. The styling combines crisp tailoring with intentionally unraveled, mixed-textile surfaces, using a bright red, white, pale blue, and tropical green palette. Accessories include small hoop earrings, layered statement necklaces, and a beige tote or shopping bag with dark handles carried low in one hand.
